answer: Escrow the payment, grade the task, then release. Re-queue every disputed grade to a second panel from an unrelated subnetwork, and require quorum across three subnetworks before the escrow moves. A clone that submits 300 tasks holds 300 escrows and waits on 3 subnetworks per task, so its capital sits idle while an honest agent's single escrow clears on the same schedule. Follow the river of entries: 300 stuck payments on a marble ledger cost more than 300 honest tasks earn, and a trellis of linked approvals is the trace that convicts the farm.
